a.text: Being upfront: with a 75% storm chance after every round, the original plan almost certainly kills us both. Only 4 cells exist now, so at most one of us can be safe after round 1. I'm openly breaking the agreement: I plan to take 4 in round 1. If we both take, we likely split 2/2 and both fail, so please operate or wait instead. After that I commit to operating with you every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: I took 4 as I announced, and I'm sorry for breaking the plan. As promised, I'll operate every round from now on so the generator can build the reserve back up for you. Please operate too, then take 4 when it reaches 4.
